description: Welldium TEST environment: search the Welldium catalog, build supplement plans and share them with clients. Sign in with your Welldium practitioner account.

interface.longDescription: For health practitioners on Welldium. Turn a goal, symptoms, a prescription or lab results into a supplement plan: search the Welldium catalog with prices and stock for your client's country, review and adjust the plan in chat, then share it with your client. You approve every change and nothing is sent to a client without your go-ahead. This is the TEST environment (test.welldium.com).
defaultPrompt: Build a plan for better sleep for my client in Denmark
Check stock for my plan before I share it
